name: Azami Shuuzou
source:
"I will go ahead and love you anyway so please do not concern yourself with it."

Occupation: Butler

Monopolistic!? Collector Butler

Although most of his background, age, height and weight are the same as his older brother's, his mental structure is a little different due being raised in an environment where his older brother was always the one who got scolded first. He is good at managing his stress thanks to the freedom he was allowed to enjoy for most of his life, and unlike his brother, he's able to recognize his own limitations by making alternative plans when requests are too unreasonable. He has always loved beautiful things, but when it comes to the things he likes his brother was always the one to receive it first, and he often got his brother's hand-me-downs, due to this he developed an habit of collecting and clinging onto the stuff he likes as if they are his personal treasures. He is interested in stamps, postcards, and recently, butterfly specimens, displaying these in his room and looking at them whenever he wants is his happiness. He met you by chance in spring at a flower shop. Although he didn't get the chance to see you after that, you two meet again when Kanetomi brings you to the mansion. He treats you with a kindness that's somewhat more human than his brother's, but the more you interact with him, the way he looks at you changes…
